rationale: I read the complete held EO 13824 (83 FR 8923, Mar. 2, 2018, 'President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition'): sec. 1 revokes EO 13545; sec. 2 amends EO 13265 (new title, preamble and rewritten secs. 1-5 including the Council, its 30-member membership with 2-year member terms, functions, administration, and new general provisions); no own sunset (the 2-year terms are member terms, not an order term). I read the complete held EO 14327 (90 FR 37993, July 31, 2025): sec. 1 'Revocation. Executive Order 13824 of February 26, 2018 (President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition), is hereby revoked.' and sec. 2 amends EO 13265 again, rewriting sections 1 through 5 and the title. The revocation is express, whole and without a savings clause; EO 14327 also replaces by its own text the sections of EO 13265 that EO 13824 had rewritten, so nothing of EO 13824's operative text remains as a separate command. Earlier endings: none. D6 (later events): the history's earlier modification is EO 14048 (Sept. 30, 2021), which further amends EO 13265 as amended by EO 13824 (sec. 7) and is effective Sept. 30, 2021; it modifies but does not end EO 13824 and precedes the revocation. No held order after July 31, 2025 names EO 13824 (searched), so no revival or extension. The history's current-law lead (U.S. Code release point) is a pointer without a held text and is not used. Provisional NO hypothesis only.
